messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Implemented Neon Pairs, including all supported board sizes, snapshots, replay validation and the replay CLI. The offline build is [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html).

**Verification:** `npm ci`, typecheck and build passed; `npm test` passed 28 unit tests; `npm run test:e2e` passed 12 browser journeys. The replay CLI’s valid and invalid output behavior was also checked.

The automated accessibility tree and grayscale face sheet are available in [evidence/accessibility-tree.md](/work/evidence/accessibility-tree.md) and [evidence/face-sheet.png](/work/evidence/face-sheet.png). Verification versions and screen reader use are recorded in [README.md](/work/README.md); no screen reader was used.
